recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-13606.

additional_context: source/fhir.ini routes datatype pages to the datatypes page by default, making source/datatypes.html the active current narrative source for the Identifier datatype text. Community searches found no human Zulip discussion or Confluence decision that changes the straightforward typo-fix conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current source/datatypes.html already contains the requested corrected wording and the obsolete typo no longer appears in source.
